profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Technology Leader with a proven track record of building, mentoring, and leading high-performing engineering teams to deliver impactful, innovative solutions. Expert in fostering collaborative environments, driving agile development, and leveraging modern technologies, including advanced AI/ML applications and GenAI agents and models for enhanced development workflows, to achieve strategic business objectives and generate new revenue streams. Dedicated to continuous improvement and empowering teams to reach their full potential.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Building technology to solve complex problems in energy optimization and wildfire detection. Passionate about leveraging software to create a more sustainable and safer world.

positions.title: Web developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and debugged user-friendly web –based applications for wholesale & receptive tour operators. For example www.majesticusa.com, www.turar-online.com.

Worked closely with developers from third party companies that consumes any web service developed by our team, supported them in any aspect required by email, phone or personally.
